    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: |-
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation
        @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressFormValidation
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it is combined with the lastName to form the read-only
            salutation ('<title> <lastName>'); when absent the salutation is
            just the lastName.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, accepted for backward
            compatibility. The value is normalized before it is stored and
            returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and internal runs of
            whitespace collapsed to a single space, it is upper-cased, and common
            street-type abbreviations are expanded as whole words (ST->STREET,
            RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE), e.g. '  12  main st ' is stored as '12 MAIN
            STREET'. Optional: an owner is accepted when it supplies an address in
            EITHER the flat form here OR a non-blank structured 'addressLine1'. On
            the response this holds the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' (with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present) when structured fields were supplied, otherwise
            the normalized flat address. When supplied directly it must not be
            blank after normalization.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased, street-type
            abbreviations expanded). An owner is accepted when it supplies a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' or a flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Normalized with the same rules as 'addressLine1'. When present it is
            appended to the normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space,
            to form the composed 'address' returned on the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.Email
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present,
            so an owner created without a postcode stays valid. When present it
            must be valid for the owner's city: for a city with a known region
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099) the postcode must fall in that region's inclusive range; a
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned exactly as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. A date later than the server's current date is rejected.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional.
            When present it is used to derive the owner's read-only ageBand,
            computed against the owner's registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's assigned id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific title and lastName joined
                by a space ('<title> <lastName>') when a title was supplied,
                otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes separated by spaces (e.g. '+61412345678' is shown as
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the E.164
                form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION the region code resolved from the owner's postcode (falling
                back to the city, else 'UNKNOWN'); FY the two-digit fiscal year of
                the business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starting
                1 July); HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedTelephone + lastName); and CHK a single Luhn check digit
                computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. A '-<n>' suffix is
                appended when the derived id collides with an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier linking owners that belong to
                the same household: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode share it automatically. Absent for owners
                created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the full lower-case
                hex SHA-256 of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail-or-empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email the
                stored lower-cased form (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName)
                the Soundex code of the owner's last name. A create is rejected
                with 409 Conflict only when this whole key equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so
                a registration on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year
                ending the following 30 June. Absent when no registrationDate
                has been assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership score. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email
                is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                time (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 for a household of three or
                more members; adds 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year (fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW,
                VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created, flagging a
                bulk signup; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the moment this owner was created, flagging that the
                city is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard identityKey duplicate, was
                created sharing an existing owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode
                while carrying a different identityKey; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one soft-matched against (same
                soundex(lastName) and postcode, different identityKey). Present
                only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}: the record is retained and still readable, but
                is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks. False for a newly created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

   - `isBlocked(domain)` — exact match, used by the existing validator.
   - `isDisposableAdjacent(email)` — the softer check: true when the email's *registrable label* (the segment before the public suffix) matches a known disposable domain's, catching lookalikes under a different subdomain or TLD (`inbox.mailinator.com`, `mailinator.net`) that slip past the exact-match block.

   ```java
   return this.possibleDuplicate

       || this.capacityWarning;
   ```
   This maps the three spec clauses to existing domain concepts: *possible duplicate* → the `possibleDuplicate` soft-match flag; *disposable-adjacent email* → the new util check; *over soft capacity* → `capacityWarning` (set when the city is at/over the soft threshold of 40, below the hard limit of 50).
